blocks.text: Comparison operators do values ya expressions ka comparison (muqabla) karte hain: barabar hain ya nahi, kaun bara hai, kaun chhota waghera. Yeh comparison ke result ke mutabiq hamesha boolean value dete hain, yani True ya False. Neeche ka program saare comparison operators istemal karta hai.

# Define variables
x, y = 10, 5
# Greater than
print(x, ">", y, "=", x > y)  # Output: 10 > 5 = True
# Less than
print(x, "<", y, "=", x < y)  # Output: 10 < 5 = False
# Equal to
print(x, "==", y, "=", x == y)  # Output: 10 == 5 = False
# Not equal to
print(x, "!=", y, "=", x != y)  # Output: 10 != 5 = True
# Greater than or equal to
print(x, ">=", y, "=", x >= y)  # Output: 10 >= 5 = True
# Less than or equal to
print(x, "<=", y, "=", x <= y)  # Output: 10 <= 5 = False

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"x, y = 10, 5": ek hi line mein do variables: x ko 10 aur y ko 5 milta hai.
"x > y": greater than (bara): 10 > 5 True.
"x < y": less than (chhota): False.
"x == y": equal to (barabar); == muqabla karta hai, = value rakhta hai. 10 aur 5 barabar nahi, False.
"x != y": not equal (barabar nahi): True.
"x >= y": bara ya barabar: True.
"x <= y": chhota ya barabar: False.
Output: "10 > 5 = True", "10 < 5 = False", "10 == 5 = False", "10 != 5 = True", "10 >= 5 = True", "10 <= 5 = False"; bilkul comments jaisa.
Khud try karein: y = 10 kar ke Run karein: ab ==, >= aur <= True honge, aur >, <, != False.
Is code mein do variables x = 10 aur y = 5 bana kar un ka comparison >, <, ==, !=, >= aur <= se kiya gaya hai. Har line ka asal output wahi hai jo comment mein likha hai, maslan "10 > 5 = True".

items: == barabar (equal to), != barabar nahi (not equal to)
>= bara ya barabar, <= chhota ya barabar

blocks.text: Har comparison ka nateeja True ya False hai. age ko 18 ya 25 kar ke Run karein aur dekhein kaun se nateeje badalte hain.

age = 17
voting_age = 18
print(age, ">", voting_age, "=", age > voting_age)
print(age, "<", voting_age, "=", age < voting_age)
print(age, "==", voting_age, "=", age == voting_age)
print(age, "!=", voting_age, "=", age != voting_age)
print(age, ">=", voting_age, "=", age >= voting_age)
print(age, "<=", voting_age, "=", age <= voting_age)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"age = 17" aur "voting_age = 18": do numbers jin ka comparison (muqabla) hoga.
Har print line pehle dono values aur operator dikhati hai, phir comparison ka nateeja (True ya False).
17 > 18 False, 17 < 18 True, 17 == 18 False, 17 != 18 True, 17 >= 18 False, 17 <= 18 True.
Output: "17 > 18 = False", "17 < 18 = True", "17 == 18 = False", "17 != 18 = True", "17 >= 18 = False", "17 <= 18 = True".
Khud try karein: age = 18 kar ke Run karein: ab ==, >= aur <= True ho jayenge, aur >, <, != False.
